_about: FGD items the coverage gate (python3 tests/entity/run.py --coverage-gate) does not require a test for: compile-time or editor-only keys, items with no game effect, items the test harness cannot observe. Item syntax as in covers tags: class, class.key, class.key=value, class:bit. Each reason says specifically why; an exemption for an item a test asserts, or one the FGD no longer has, fails the gate.

items.monster_gargantua:65536: Non-solid corpse: the Gargantua leaves no corpse (CGargantua::RunTask TASK_DIE explodes it into gibs and removes it, gargantua.cpp)
items.env_model:32: Always send to clients: it marks the entity to be sent outside the PVS (g_bAlwaysSend, read by AddToFullPack); the test layer records no packet entities, so what a client receives is not observable here
items.game_score:2: Team Points: AddPointsToTeam gives the points to the activator's teammates (GR_TEAMMATE) only; co-op, Bounty Killer and deathmatch have no teams (PlayerRelationship is GR_NOTTEAMMATE for every player), only team play does, and the harness's test players join no team

items.game_player_team.target: Team play only: the game_team_master it names gives the team for CGameRules::ChangePlayerTeam, which does nothing outside the team play game rules (gamerules.h); the entity test maps are co-op maps
items.game_player_team:2: Team play only: Kill Player is passed to CGameRules::ChangePlayerTeam, which does nothing outside the team play game rules (gamerules.h); the entity test maps are co-op maps
items.game_player_team:4: Team play only: Gib Player is passed to CGameRules::ChangePlayerTeam, which does nothing outside the team play game rules (gamerules.h); the entity test maps are co-op maps
items.game_team_master.teamindex: Team play only: outside the team play game rules every team matches (UTIL_TeamsMatch, util.cpp), so the index changes nothing on a co-op or Bounty Killer map
items.worldspawn.mapteams: Team play only: the team play game rules take their team list from it (CHalfLifeTeamplay, teamplay_gamerules.cpp); no other game rules read it, and the entity test maps are co-op maps
items.scripted_action:8: Leave Corpse acts on a monster that dies by its script's animation (the script death event 1000 in a scripted_sequence death animation, CineCleanup); a scripted_action plays an activity's animation, and no model in valve/ or syndicate/ has that event in an activity's sequence
items.aiscripted_sequence:16384: Force idle animation looping loops the script's Idle Animation while it waits (schedule.cpp TASK_WAIT_FOR_SCRIPT); aiscripted_sequence has no Idle Animation in the FGD and its PossessEntity plays none, so there is nothing to loop
